```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
devtools::load_all()
```

# Load melted data

```{r}
##Issue with sample MS_204 (I guess there was an extra ";" in the text of one of the columns)
data16S <- tidyr::as_tibble(read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "16S_melt_without_MS_204.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=";"))|>
dplyr::mutate(Marker="16S")
head(data16S)

##Issue with sample MS_204 (I guess there was an extra ";" in the text of one of the columns)
dataITS <- tidyr::as_tibble(read.table(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "ITS_melt_without_MS_204.csv"), header=TRUE, sep=";"))|>
dplyr::mutate(Marker="ITS")

data <- dplyr::bind_rows(data16S, dataITS)

## OTU present or absent
data <- data |>
dplyr::mutate(present=dplyr::if_else(Abundance>0, 1, 0))
```

# Taxa across all three fruits
## Compute frequency across all three fruits 
```{r}

freq_data <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()


freq_data_70 <- freq_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Frequency>0.7) |>
  tidyr::separate(col = "OTU", into=c(NA, "OTU_ID"), sep="_",
  remove = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(OTU_ID=as.numeric(OTU_ID)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Marker, OTU_ID) 

write.table(x=freq_data_70, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "freq_OTU.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE)

```

## Prevalence
```{r}
prevalence_data <- freq_data |>
  dplyr::filter(OTU%in%freq_data_70$OTU)|>
  dplyr::mutate(OTUname=paste(Genus, OTU, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(SampleType_Sample_size=paste0(SampleType, " (n=", Sample_size, ")")) |>
  dplyr::select(Marker, OTUname, OTU, SampleType, SampleType_Sample_size, Frequency)

prevalence_data_wide <- prevalence_data |>
  dplyr::select(-SampleType_Sample_size) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = SampleType, values_from = Frequency)

write.table(x=prevalence_data_wide, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "prevalence_data.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE)
```

## Make plot
```{r}
p16S <- prevalence_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker=="16S")|>
  ggplot(aes(SampleType_Sample_size, OTUname, fill= Frequency)) + 
  geom_tile()+
scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="blue") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

pITS <- prevalence_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Marker=="ITS")|>
  ggplot(aes(SampleType_Sample_size, OTUname, fill= Frequency)) + 
  geom_tile()+
scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="blue") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

panel <- p16S + pITS+
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
panel
ggsave(filename = "prevalence_allfruits.jpg", path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition"), width = 30, height = 20, units = "cm")
```

# Taxa across per fruit
## Compute frequency per fruit 
```{r}

freq_data_fruit <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(Marker, FruitType, SampleType, OTU, Family, Genus, Species) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Frequency = mean(present), Sample_size=dplyr::n())|>
  dplyr::ungroup()


freq_data_fruit70 <- freq_data_fruit |>
  dplyr::filter(Frequency>0.7) |>
  tidyr::separate(col = "OTU", into=c(NA, "OTU_ID"), sep="_",
  remove = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(OTU_ID=as.numeric(OTU_ID)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Marker, OTU_ID, FruitType)

write.table(x=freq_data_fruit70, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "freq_OTU_fruit.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE)

```


## Prevalence per fruit type
```{r}

prevalence_data_fruit <- freq_data_fruit |>
  dplyr::filter(OTU%in%freq_data_fruit70$OTU)|>
  dplyr::mutate(OTUname=paste(Genus, OTU, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(SampleType_Fruit=paste(SampleType, FruitType, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType=paste(FruitType, SampleType, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(SampleType_Fruit_Sample_size=paste0(SampleType_Fruit, "(n=",Sample_size, ")"))|>
  dplyr::mutate(Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size=paste0(Fruit_SampleType, "(n=", Sample_size, ")"))|>
  dplyr::select(Marker, OTUname, OTU, SampleType, SampleType_Fruit, Fruit_SampleType, SampleType_Fruit_Sample_size, FruitType, Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size, Frequency)

prevalence_data_fruit_wide <- prevalence_data_fruit  |>
  dplyr::select(-SampleType) |>
    dplyr::select(-FruitType) |>
  dplyr::select(-Fruit_SampleType) |>
    dplyr::select(-SampleType_Fruit_Sample_size) |>
  dplyr::select(-Fruit_SampleType_Sample_size) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = SampleType_Fruit, values_from = Frequency)

write.table(x=prevalence_data_fruit_wide, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "prevalence_data_fruit.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r}
scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="blue") +
```

## Make plot Fruit_SampleType
